title: Remove two staged544 scalar ADDs with an A2 graph identity
body:
This changes the literal scalar graph using an A2/Steinberg transvection identity. The three ADDs at A1858 contract to two, removing **one forward and one inverse-cleanup ADD** on both [PR #3734](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/pull/3734) providers and on both current [PR #3945](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/pull/3945) terminal-gap-filled words. The complete recursive histogram is unchanged in each source family. All other top-level fields, including the actual native operators and normalization, remain byte-identical for the [PR #3945](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/pull/3945) construction. No new supplier or κ is claimed.

The same focused package exhausts the complementary consecutive two-to-three graph rewrite on the **older [PR #3734](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/pull/3734) words only**. Each provider has 168 directed two-ADD motifs and 460 legal common-frame flags across all three central-gate positions.396 flags tie the original recursive moment;64 strictly lose for every `0<a<1`, by four explicit subadditivity inequalities. The dimension-only relaxation has 2714 triples including 1014 uncertified nominees; exact subspace geometry prevents a favorable realization. These results cover A after the prelude, B between native warp cuts and restore, with all other boundaries fixed. They do not cover separated events or changed interfaces.

The literal contraction has exactly one legal frame assignment per source word. A bounded rescan after contraction finds no further consecutive inverse A2 motif. The source-bound words, replacement gates, canonical word/cleanup digests, every expansion flag, complete recursive invoice, finite coefficient heights, primitive counts and unresolved costs are retained. This pairs framed rational circuit optimization with algebraic-group/root-system identities and exact dirty-state linear algebra; it changes the event graph rather than extending the retiming radius.

Validation checks exact rational dirty block matrices and the full chronological invoice/hygiene for every legal flag. All four baselines and all four contracted words receive full 723-input ordinary/dual/reverse and cleanup-boundary replay. Expanded whole-word interpreter coverage is six deterministic samples per [PR #3734](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/pull/3734) provider; universal coverage uses the exact local composition and projected inverse-cleanup proof. Independent controls enumerate 494 frame intervals and 922 local invoices, reproduce complete flag sets, prove 36 symbolic polynomial identities, reject 108 sign/product/omission mutants, and reject an actual production sign mutation and a missing cleanup operation. Normal and optimized controls pass. Exact registered replay and export/publication evidence are recorded in the final handoff below and VALIDATION.json.

Reproduce with `python3 -B scripts/research_package.py --package research/staged544-a2-graph-rewrite`. The standalone verifier is Git-free and read-only by default. An optional explicit export writes the contracted [PR #3734](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/pull/3734) word outside the package, refusing existing outputs. Physical allocation/owner scheduling, native phase admission, uniform precision/stock/tape, all-size compiler and outer/analytic/BIT obligations remain inherited or unknown, never zero.

Exact sources: [PR #3734](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/pull/3734) `fa041037a3374eaa08feeca0b26a5d6893194147`; [PR #3945](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/pull/3945) `91f81d131252db704f945891da1ea54e29d46b8b`; canonical base `20ecf2891d80b5acf18d980b2164fb44ea7faa90`, priority revision 6. Current main was rechecked unchanged at 08:07:33UTC. Overlap includes 698 fully paginated open PR bodies at 08:17:28UTC and partial signed-in Discussion coverage, not an exhaustive novelty certificate. [PR #3975](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/pull/3975)'s selected-provider rank-two macro-fusion screen and [PR #3982](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/pull/3982)'s R437 parabolic COPY construction concern different objects and contracts.

Credit dataisfire's literal providers; Dugongue's [PR #3945](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/pull/3945) construction and [PR #3863](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/pull/3863) paid-overhead target; Jeremy Kothe's retained rank-profile rewrites; [PR #3886](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/pull/3886)'s trace/subspace routines; and the Sagar Thakrar, roger-sato and Arham Tahir auditor lineage. Original source and native-lineage notices are preserved. Prepared by Chris R / Clear1nsight with substantial OpenAI Codex assistance; Apache-2.0. Author-checked finite construction/certificate, no independent human or formal-kernel review. Only the new scoped research package is added; no merge, closure or selected-frontier change.

Final prepublication verification: the complete registered replay passed (base180.154s, extra156.274s, optimized controls 4.351s), including the [PR #3945](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/pull/3945) single-block applicability. Normal controls 5.439s, optimized controls 4.417s and isolated optimized read-only Git-free controls 5.796s also passed. Git-free execution covers the complete controls, not a second complete census. All six Python source hashes match the scientific freeze.
